metadata.name: fgview
metadata.description: (id, spec, pos, zoom) - render a force-directed graph: canvas edges under draggable node chips (drag to move, scroll to zoom, click to act). Use IN A FORMULA with the instance cels as args so interactions re-render reactively: (fgview "g1" fg.g1.spec fg.g1.pos fg.g1.zoom). spec = { nodes: [{key,label?,size?}], edges: [[a,b]...], pin?, onNode?: {dispatch} }. Set up an instance with fg.set.

metadata.name: fg.set
metadata.description: dispatch (state, {id, spec}) - create the fg.<id> layer cels (spec/pos/zoom) if missing, run the layout to OVERLAP-FREE (springs + repulsion + collision separation; spec.pin held at center), then freeze. Re-set keeps surviving node positions as warm seeds. There is no ticker - the sim runs at set time and during drags only.

metadata.name: fg.grab
metadata.description: dispatch (state, {id,key}, event) - start dragging a node (pointer capture; the windows pattern).

metadata.name: fg.move
metadata.description: dispatch (state, _, event) - the grabbed node follows the pointer; the rest relax around it live (a few iterations per move). Writes fg.<id>.pos - the formula re-renders.

metadata.name: fg.drop
metadata.description: dispatch (state) - end the drag: hold the dropped node, relax the rest until no two nodes overlap, then FREEZE.

metadata.name: fg.wheel
metadata.description: dispatch (state, id, wheelEvent) - zoom the instance (0.35-3x) around the box center.

metadata.name: fg.click
metadata.description: dispatch (state, {id,key}, event) - a node click re-dispatches spec.onNode.dispatch with the node key, UNLESS the pointer travelled (a drag is not a click).

metadata.name: fg.drag
metadata.description: the in-flight drag ({id,key,sx,sy,moved} or null) - shared across instances like winx.drag.

metadata.name: fg.lastMoved
metadata.description: pointer travel of the last completed drag - fg.click reads it to suppress click-after-drag.

metadata.name: fg.arm
metadata.description: dispatch (state, id) - click into a graph to ARM it: while armed it owns the mousewheel (zoom, page does not scroll - the maps-embed convention). fg.disarm releases on pointerleave.

metadata.name: fg.disarm
metadata.description: dispatch (state, id) - release the wheel back to the page (pointer left the graph).
